positioningStatement: The Corporate Desk is Australia's premium commercial workspace solutions partner — combining the quality of high-end commercial furniture brands with the service certainty, local presence, and project management of a premium fitout firm.

vs_VolumeRetailers.difference: TCD offers commercial-grade quality, 6-year warranty, professional installation, project management, and a relationship — not a transaction
vs_VolumeRetailers.keyMessage: You're not buying furniture. You're investing in a workspace that works for the next 6+ years.

vs_GreyImporters.difference: TCD has Australian warranty, Australian compliance, local support, and installation certainty
vs_GreyImporters.keyMessage: When something goes wrong (and it does), TCD is in Brisbane. They are not.

vs_PremiumInternationalBrands.difference: TCD offers comparable commercial quality at 40–60% lower investment, with faster lead times and local project management
vs_PremiumInternationalBrands.keyMessage: Commercial-grade quality without the premium brand premium.

vs_LocalCommercialSuppliers.difference: TCD's AI-powered planning tools, deeper range (330 SKUs across 5 supplier divisions), and 6-year warranty are structural advantages
vs_LocalCommercialSuppliers.keyMessage: We combine the range of a major supplier with the personal service of a boutique firm.

brandPerception.current: Premium commercial office furniture supplier — known for quality, local presence, and project delivery
brandPerception.target: Australia's most trusted partner for corporate workspace transformation
bridgeActivities: Project case studies demonstrating scale and quality

must_maintain: 4-hour response time to all qualified enquiries
Handwritten thank-you note or gift on large project handovers
must_avoid: Generic email auto-replies without a person's name
Products visible on Alibaba or direct-to-consumer platforms
